summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial tests two different drug treatments, pitavastatin and PCSK9 inhibitors, in patients who have received a liver transplant and have high levels of fats in their blood called hyperlipidemia. The study looks at how well these treatments lower cholesterol levels known as LDL-C. A total of 59 participants are enrolled in the study. The current status of the trial is Active, not recruiting.

facts.sponsor: National Medical Research Center for Therapy and Preventive Medicine
